Name: Color Shared Chests
Author: liutianzhen
Description:
Color Shared Chests - 彩色共享箱子
Version: 1.0.6 (Experimental)
Author: Liutianzhen11

Color Shared Chests connects supported chests of the same dye colour across locations in one save. Rename individual chests and optionally add inventory rows. Chinese and English UI included.

[size=4][b]FEATURES[/b][/size]
• Same-colour shared inventory across locations; different colours use different groups.
• Supports regular wood/stone chests and big wood/stone chests. Fridges and special/modded chest types are not supported.
• Undyed chests stay independent by default. The 20 dye colours participate by default.
• Rename each chest independently. Optional capacity extension adds 0–10 rows of 12 slots; disabled by default.
• Shared capacity equals the largest single chest capacity in the group, not the sum of all chests.

[size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS / INSTALL[/b][/size]
Requires SMAPI 4.5.2 or later. Built against Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Windows; other game versions and platforms are not independently verified here.
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, for in-game configuration.
1. Back up your save and install SMAPI.
2. Unzip ColorSharedChests-1.0.6-MIT.zip into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Ensure Mods/ColorSharedChests contains ColorSharedChests.dll and manifest.json directly.
4. Launch through SMAPI. All multiplayer participants should install the same version.

[size=4][b]HOW TO USE[/b][/size]
Dye supported chests the same colour to access their shared inventory.
Open a chest and click Rename; Ctrl+N is a fallback. Clear the name to restore the default.
Scroll over chest inventory slots to change rows. Mouse-wheel browsing also works while holding an item. When inventory exceeds the visible area, drag the vertical scrollbar with an empty hand or click its track.
Close the chest menu, then Ctrl+right-click a nearby chest to pick it up.
Use Generic Mod Config Menu or edit config.json while the game is closed. Capacity and sharing have independent switches; host settings control shared rules.

[size=4][b]IMPORTANT INVENTORY BEHAVIOUR[/b][/size]
Changing a chest colour leaves its previous shared inventory with the old colour group. Place a chest with the old colour to access it again.
Merging, shrinking or disabling sharing may produce overflow: check your backpack and nearby dropped items. Back up before changing sharing rules.

[size=4][b]MULTIPLAYER / COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]
The owner reports in-game testing. This upload does not claim exhaustive coverage of every platform, multiplayer scenario or other mod.
Chests Anywhere and Automate integration exists, but broad compatibility and concurrent inventory operations are not guaranteed. Test combinations on a backup save.
Experimental release: report reproducible issues, especially inventory migration, overflow and concurrent access.

[size=4][b]UNINSTALL SAFELY[/b][/size]
Do not remove the mod while shared inventory remains.
As the host, close chest menus, run colorchests_status and then colorchests_export in the SMAPI console. Verify all items, save and exit before removing the folder. If stored items remain inaccessible, place a regular chest and export again.

[size=4][b]SUPPORT[/b][/size]
Include game, SMAPI and mod versions; host/farmhand role; other chest/automation mods; reproduction steps and SMAPI errors. Remove personal details and invite codes from public logs.

需要 SMAPI 4.5.2 或更高版本，Generic Mod Config Menu 可选。解压安装包，将 ColorSharedChests 文件夹放进 Mods，通过 SMAPI 启动。联机所有人安装相同版本，由房主管理全局规则。
